newsitem.title: THAILAND: Banpu buys Indonesian coal mine.
newsitem.headline: Banpu buys Indonesian coal mine.

text.p: Thai coal firm Banpu Plc has bought a 95 percent stake in a venture to mine coal in Indonesia which is scheduled to come on stream in 1998, the company's senior executives said on Monday.
The firm has acquired a coal mine in Kalimantan which will produce 2 million tonnes per year, Ongart Auapinyakul, senior vice-president of Banpu told a news conference.
"Seventy percent of total production will be exported to Thailand while the remaining 30 percent will be sold in Indonesia," he said.
Ongart told Reuters that he expected total revenue from the coal mine in Indonesia to reach $40 million in its first year.
Banpu has acquired 95 percent of the total shares held by previous owner PT Jorong Barutama Greston Company Ltd.
Ongart said the company had paid 23.75 million baht for the stake in December last year.
